# Reuters: China's Guangdong province plans to move data centres undersea

Published: 14 Dec 2021.

## Key Findings
- Guangdong province (major tech hub, southeast coast) plans to move some big data centres to **undersea sites** to cut energy use.
- Plan published Tuesday (Dec 14, 2021).
- Data centres have emerged as one of the biggest industrial consumers of energy.
- Building them underwater reduces cooling energy costs (seawater natural cooling).

## Context
- This was the original 2021 plan that preceded the 2025-2027 Marine Economy Action Plan (sources 35-37).
